"""Tests for subject.extract_registry_update."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from subject import (
    EnumSessionPhase,
    EnumSessionRegistryStatus,
    extract_registry_update,
)


def _event(**overrides):
    base = {
        "task_id": "task-1",
        "session_id": "sess-1",
        "correlation_id": "corr-1",
        "event_type": "session.started",
        "emitted_at": "2026-01-15T10:30:00+00:00",
    }
    base.update(overrides)
    return base


def test_returns_none_without_task_id():
    assert extract_registry_update(
        {"session_id": "sess-1", "event_type": "session.started"}
    ) is None


def test_returns_none_for_null_task_id():
    assert extract_registry_update(_event(task_id=None)) is None


def test_returns_none_for_empty_task_id():
    assert extract_registry_update(_event(task_id="")) is None


def test_returns_none_for_non_string_task_id():
    assert extract_registry_update(_event(task_id=12345)) is None


def test_basic_entry_fields():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event())
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.task_id == "task-1"
    assert entry.status == EnumSessionRegistryStatus.ACTIVE
    assert entry.session_ids == ["sess-1"]
    assert entry.correlation_ids == ["corr-1"]


def test_phase_planning_for_session_started():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(event_type="session.started"))
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.current_phase == EnumSessionPhase.PLANNING


def test_phase_completed_for_session_ended():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(event_type="session.ended"))
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.current_phase == EnumSessionPhase.COMPLETED


def test_phase_reviewing_for_decision_recorded():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(event_type="decision.recorded"))
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.current_phase == EnumSessionPhase.REVIEWING


def test_phase_implementing_for_implementing_event_types():
    for event_type in (
        "prompt.submitted",
        "tool.executed",
        "context.injected",
        "manifest.injected",
        "agent.status",
        "task.delegated",
    ):
        entry = extract_registry_update(_event(event_type=event_type))
        assert entry is not None
        assert entry.current_phase == EnumSessionPhase.IMPLEMENTING, event_type


def test_unknown_event_type_yields_none_phase():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(event_type="something.else"))
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.current_phase is None


def test_missing_event_type_yields_none_phase():
    event = _event()
    del event["event_type"]
    entry = extract_registry_update(event)
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.current_phase is None


def test_emitted_at_string_is_parsed():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event())
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.last_activity == datetime.fromisoformat("2026-01-15T10:30:00+00:00")


def test_emitted_at_datetime_passthrough():
    dt = datetime(2026, 5, 1, 9, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(emitted_at=dt))
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.last_activity == dt


def test_invalid_emitted_at_falls_back_to_now():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(emitted_at="not-a-timestamp"))
    assert entry is not None
    assert isinstance(entry.last_activity, datetime)
    assert entry.last_activity.tzinfo is not None


def test_missing_emitted_at_falls_back_to_now():
    event = _event()
    del event["emitted_at"]
    entry = extract_registry_update(event)
    assert entry is not None
    assert isinstance(entry.last_activity, datetime)
    assert entry.last_activity.tzinfo is not None


def test_non_string_emitted_at_falls_back_to_now():
    entry = extract_registry_update(_event(emitted_at=12345))
    assert entry is not None
    assert isinstance(entry.last_activity, datetime)
    assert entry.last_activity.tzinfo is not None


def test_files_touched_for_edit_tool_with_file_path():
    entry = extract_registry_update(
        _event(event_type="tool.executed", tool_name="Edit", file_path="src/app.py")
    )
    assert entry is not None
    assert entry.files_touched == ["src/app.py"]


def test_files_touched_for_write_tool_with_path_key():
    entry = extract_registry_update(
        _event(event_type="tool.executed", tool_name="Write", path="docs/readme.md")
    )

def test_file_path_preferred_over_path():
    entry = extract_registry_update(
        _event(

            tool_name="Bash",
            file_path="a.txt",
            path="b.txt",
        )
